name: Bolton Summer 2024
information: ## Please note we'll be using a different car park this time. There are also planned road closures on the Sunday of the competition. Please refer to [Travel](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoltonSummer2024#35015-travel) tab for more info. Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. **Spectators may attend for free.
